description: A scripted run of the demo API over transparency-dataset.json#/store, one call at a time: the function, its arguments, the outcome (`ok` with the result, `error` with the message) and the store delta per collection (`added` records, `removed` ids, `changed` whole new records). Covers every MOD1 write the demo API has and the reads whose rules the module mirrors (campaign stats, user permissions and verification visibility). The `transactions` delta of createVerification belongs to MOD2.

env.defined_at: rust/tools/src/transparency.ts#withFrozenClock: replaces Date and crypto.randomUUID while the demo API runs (it has no LedgerEnv)
env.new_id: 00000000-0000-4000-8000- then n left-padded with 0 to 12 digits, n = 1, 2, 3, ... (a UUID v4 shape), one per crypto.randomUUID() call
